languageReview.notes: English and Chinese versions consistently describe the $3.9 billion initial Series F closing, the $30.9 billion post-money valuation, the co-lead investors (Atreides, Mubadala, Valor), and maintain exact currency symbols ($3.9B, $30.9B / 39 亿美元, 309 亿美元).

identity.action: Crusoe closes initial $3.9 billion Series F at $30.9 billion valuation
identity.deduplicationReason: Discrete equity capitalization milestone; legally and commercially distinct from prior debt/equity rounds.

classification.reason: Corporate equity financing round and company valuation change of an AI compute infrastructure operator.

significance.rationale: Financing round and equity valuation are verified, but private equity financing does not establish an executed restructuring of market supply, demand, or trading rules affecting outside entities under L2-COMMERCE.
significance.whyNotHigher: Under SIG-01 and SIG-02, financing amount, valuation scale, and planned capital expenditure do not constitute executed market-structure change; hence criteria remain null.
significance.whyNotLower: Large-scale equity round initial closing is verified by primary company release and independent financial media.

structural_change_executed.rationale: Equity financing has completed initial closing, but industry-wide market rules or trading structures have not been executed.

external_actors_affected.rationale: Data center and energy capacity additions are future plans; verified operational impact on two external actors is not observed.

consensus.reason: Initial closing recently announced; planned capital deployment and operational expansions remain forward-looking.

dispute.reason: No documented factual disagreement regarding the initial closing terms, co-leads, or valuation.

evidence.quote: Crusoe, the industry’s first vertically-integrated AI infrastructure provider, today announced the initial closing of its anticipated $3.9 billion Series F funding round, at a $30.9 billion post-money valuation.
Data center developer Crusoe said Thursday it raised $3.9 billion in a Series F round that pushes its valuation to $30.9 billion.
